info.title: Ablaki World Economy
info.description: Code prepared, not tested or deployed. Exact existing wallet requires explicit offline activation. Owner-only balances, FIFO manual collection, reserved obligations and funded parent payments. Versioned policy publication requires world-manage and p-admin. Losses run only in the trusted worker; HTTP waits for catch-up. No minting or personal withdrawals.
